description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for managing firmware upgrades, including file installation, hook execution, device identification, partition handling, and firmware flashing commands.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by reading image and writing to MTD partition, optionally using a backup.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to indicate an upgrade process is underway.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies or links files into RAM_ROOT, handling symlinks and regular files.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs an executable binary and its dependencies.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts user for a yes/no answer with default.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads image data from a source, handling compression based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Reads image data with dd, handling progress and errors.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Gets magic word from image for format identification.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Gets long magic value from image for format identification.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Gets GPT magic from image.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Gets VFAT magic from image.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Gets FAT32 magic from image.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies image format based on magic value.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks if image has EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks if image has FAT or FAT32 magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Determines and exports the boot device based on kernel command line.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports partition device based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts little-endian 32-bit hex to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from device and outputs partition info.
